description: Use when the user wants to edit the fields or replace the tags of an existing note. Do not use when the user only wants to inspect note content (use anki_get_note_info) or delete it (use anki_delete_note). Safety: confirm with the user before overwriting note content.

fields.description: Note fields keyed by exact model field names. For Basic: {Front: 'question', Back: 'answer'}.

tags.description: Replacement tag list. Pass an empty array to clear tags.

name: anki_update_note
title: Update Anki Note
